limitations: Synthetic paused Chromium native two-contact touch emulation with software WebGL; not physical-device certification.

Captures release contacts and pause; automatic roughly 3s live / 1.2s FIRE boundaries shorten waits. Inspected timings and images each batch. No inference of human reaction-time or causal quality benefit.
Physical phones, Safari, audio, hardware performance and continuous enjoyment unassessed.
Automatic contact release on every capture cannot establish continuous held-burst rearming comfort.
Pause clears AIM and closes TOOLS; AIM/tools were not assessed. No inference from a zoomed projection.
Assisted route completion is not evidence of manual traversal quality. Combat samples include simultaneous manual MOVE and FIRE drag but assistance and paused observations limit conclusions.
Two short assisted completions support observations of this mission only; no inference of enjoyment from unassessed memories, weapons or settings.
learningBeforeAttempt2: Route/approach labels guide objectives; scene taps assist aim; coil OFF indicators track progress. Avoid spending FIRE during reload; use fresh screenshots after view changes.

protocol.inputs: Native JSON-lines two-contact touch; visible selectors and screenshot geometry. Every returned screenshot viewed separately before adaptive input; no stale target sequence.
protocol.boundaries: Actual timings/observationBoundary inspected; requested 3000ms waits commonly shortened to about 2980ms, and one 1100ms FIRE wait shortened. No attempt to bypass.
protocol.identity: Menu visibly BUILD 123. Source SHA provided by requester, not independently verified under visible-only restriction.

scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 functional with substantial friction; 7 good with noticeable limitations; 10 exceptional across assessed use. Scores reflect observed friction/features, not win/loss or physical-device certification. Unassessed features receive no invented credit.

reasons.overallMobile: Coherent and finishable assisted mission with clear progress and generous touch controls; small targets, crowded screen and uncertain selection/cover friction keep it below exceptional.
reasons.controls: Two-contact movement/firing and scene swipe worked. One right-edge tap failed and needed correction; assistance prevents claims about precise aim, sustained holds or actual thumb comfort.
reasons.gameplay: Recoveries, coil sequence and upload provide changing goals with readable feedback. Route assistance dominated traversal, armor/cover firing caused wasted inputs, and long-term challenge/enjoyment remains unassessed.
reasons.presentation: Rain, cool teal palette, warm floor lighting, relay machinery and cohesive title/result screens create a strong consistent atmosphere. Audio and hardware rendering/performance unassessed.
reasons.usability: Context-sensitive route/approach, threat directions, map and explicit fresh start were useful. Off-camera threats while following route and dense overlays demand attention.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo, main buttons and progress indicators are legible. Small environmental signs/map legend, distant enemies and overlapping weapon/control area are less comfortable at 844x390.

learningBetweenAttempts.learned: Route/approach transitions, assisted tap aim, coil OFF indicators and reload behavior from attempt 1.
learningBetweenAttempts.applied: Inspected map in attempt 2, tried opening MOVE/FIRE without scene tap, waited explicitly for reload before final coil shot.
learningBetweenAttempts.notClaimed: No reaction-time improvement or causal quality benefit inferred; scores not derived from score/time change.
